Execution order: Markdown step 12 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 35 (Markdown 11/12 — Add controlled adoption of existing design Markdown). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Complete the feature with automated conformance and real desktop/MCP evidence after all preceding Markdown tasks pass. This gate covers currently implemented SQLite and text backends; future server SQL parity remains explicitly required by storage tasks 20-23.
Scope:
- Extend the common storage suite for complete bodies, identity, all read paths, schema/format upgrades, references/backlinks, tokens, no-op/replay, concurrent writes/deletes, atomic rollback, notifications and read-only byte/mtime/revision preservation.
- Cover SQLite/text conversion and independent-clone Git scenarios with Markdown, associations, bindings and task/QA links.
- Exercise real stdio MCP plus native Tauri/WebView2: create via MCP, discover/open in desktop, edit with the reused Markdown editor, preview, save, retrieve via MCP, follow a task/QA link, and read the full generated file from a nearby architecture short.
- Demonstrate fresh-token conflict resolution preserves drafts; deletion reports dependencies; rename preserves references; stale output/failure is visible; unchanged regeneration is write-free; imported sources stay intact.
- Include path ownership/collision handling, safe preview/link behavior, no silently truncated full documents, large-document responsiveness and bounded discovery payloads.
- Rebuild/reconnect the MCP process and test the real desktop build. Record evidence in QA jobs/runs and task completion, then update formal design status from pending to implemented only for verified behavior.
Acceptance:
- Every available backend passes the same domain contract and native/MCP user path. Existing C4/UML/mockup/task/QA workflows remain usable.
- Documentation, help, agent template and generated notice agree with the shipped API.
- List any unimplemented SQL capability explicitly and retain its acceptance gate in task 23; do not claim future-server validation.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.

data.title: Markdown 12/12 — Verify complete native, MCP and storage parity
